about: Rough patches (dungeon/life/rough_patches.py): why a companion called off a plan with the user at the last minute. Picked by seeded dice; said in the companion's own words. No gendered words. `needs` lists the reasons that only fit some eras: modern (modern, future and other worlds), motor (also the jazz age: cars and buses) and rail (also the Victorian, frontier and steampunk eras: trains, trams, plumbing, lifts); medieval and fantasy worlds draw from the rest.
